## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_劫财 (Water carrying The Rival). Persona The Rival (劫财). Definition line: "Same nature, different register, the edge of comparison". Keyword Rivalry, charge fierce, poles catalyst Daring / friction Drain. Family function: Body. Cost dimension: comparison as fuel; the race never announces a finish. Arena: the race, the shared prize, the other runner. Classical portrait: same nature, different register; comparison as fuel; the race with no announced finish. Ruled domains: Rivalry, Shared stakes, Boldness. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 比肩.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Depth meeting depth cross-polarity — intelligence competing with intelligence".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Rival: current that races current. You compete the way tides do, quietly, continuously, gaining by inches that look like accidents. Shared flows suit you: pooled funds, joint journeys, split winnings. Just remember that merged water is hard to unmix. Mark what is yours before the confluence."
- k2_functional: "Your energy ebbs and floods: read your own tide chart and schedule accordingly."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Undermining","Envious","Slippery"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Rivalry":"Your rivalries run underwater: unspoken races, silent measurements, positions gained without visible waves. Surface one or two. A named, laughing rivalry refreshes you more than ten secret ones.","Shared stakes":"Money and effort pool around you like watersheds: group funds, family flows, blended accounts. You track it all mentally and forgive it all eventually. Put banks around what must not flood away.","Boldness":"Your daring is fluid: risks taken by drift and momentum more than announcement. It carries you far. Just check occasionally that the current you are riding is one you chose."}

Mood, motivation, entertainment, repair: all generated onboard, no docking required. Days alone pass without friction, and company, when chosen, is a preference rather than a need. People sense the completeness and find it either restful or quietly unnerving."

Core element Water, energy element Water. Law: Water and Water are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Water is this core's Body. value.text: A race gets all of you moving. You run on a small supply of Water, so you would rather chase a real person than follow a plan. Name one race a season out loud, and the racing feeds you more than it costs.

value_b.text: Loving a race is how you love the work. Water comes in slowly for you and nothing refills it like someone to beat, and you put the race ahead of the task. Keep a rival you like, and the race stays a game worth running.

value.text: Jumping in first is how you learn what a thing is really like. Water is short in you, and you would rather be inside a decision than stand beside it planning. Jump in where the stakes are shared, and the first mistake costs you half.

value_b.text: You jump in first and ask about the depth afterwards. Waiting at the side feels worse to you than being wrong, and you go first instead of going sure. Keep jumping, and bring one person who checks the depth before you.

value.text: Going all in together is the only way you go in. Shared stakes feel more real to you than a safe share kept back, so you pool money and effort. Choose people who count as carefully as you trust, and going all in pays.

value_b.text: You go all in together or you do not go in. A shared risk feels lighter than one carried alone, and you pool first and sort out shares later. Name your part before you go in, and you keep both the partner and the money.

value.text: Inside a shared stake, you are at your bravest. A pooled stake feels like company, and all in feels better to you than keeping some back. Keep one share out of every pool, and you only ever lose what you can afford.

value.text: All in together means you take someone with you every time. You put the shared stake ahead of the question of whose it was, and a partner carries losses they never signed for. Agree the shares before the risk, and they stay a partner afterwards.
